capabilities: Edit a Markdown note as slides with a thumbnail rail and grid sorter
Reorder, add, duplicate, and delete slides by drag and drop
Edit titles and subtitles inline and normalize heading levels file-wide
Keep private presenter notes in [!slide] callouts below each slide
Present fullscreen with keyboard navigation and theme-inherited styling
extras: Not yet listed in Obsidian's Community Plugins directory; installed manually from GitHub releases, with build files verifiable via gh artifact attestations. Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later.
intentEvidence: Markdown Slides can put a note on a screen. That alone is not enough to build a serious presentation.
motivation: The author finds that developing content inside PowerPoint's slide objects gets in the way of writing and restructuring, and that Markdown lacked a visual presentation editor.
problem: Obsidian can display a Markdown note as slides, but offers no visual way to see, reorder, and design a deck while keeping the content as plain Markdown.

relations.evidence: Pele is optional and supplied by Obsidian.

summary: Visual slide editor that turns a Markdown note into presentation slides with a thumbnail rail, sorter, automatic layouts, and a fullscreen player.
